title: VR perf hypothesis
description: One Phase 1 analyst hypothesis (spec 2026-10-15-vr-perf-team-design.md). .claude/workflows/vr-perf-analysis.js inlines this shape as HYPOTHESIS; tools/vr-emulator/vr-perf-analysis.test.js keeps the two equal.

id.description: Short kebab-case id, unique within the run, e.g. gpu-static-batching

claim.description: What costs time, where, and what change would remove it, in one or two sentences

evidence.description: file:line references or trace references (file plus event/label)

expectedMsSaved.description: Predicted headset p90 ms saved per benchmark set (perf-benchmarks.json)

falsification.description: A cheap test whose failure would refute the claim

files.description: Repo-relative files a fix would touch; wave items must not overlap

bigBet.description: Multiview, workers, WebGPU or similar: never a normal wave item, becomes a spike proposal

upstreamCandidate.description: Worth offering to KotOR.js upstream (tagged only, never posted)
